about.title: About us
about.intro: prepza helps companies find people who really know the job: a fair, timed interview made from your job description, at a price any team can afford. And anyone preparing for an interview can practise for free.
about.description: prepza turns a job description into a fair, timed interview in minutes, at a price any team can afford, and lets anyone practise for interviews for free.

company.title: Why we exist
company.problem: Hiring often rests on a CV and a good conversation, and both can mislead. The assessment tools that help are priced for big companies, with annual plans and seat fees, so most teams go without.
company.approach: prepza turns a job description into a timed interview in minutes, for any role. Every candidate gets their own questions, you see who knows the job and why, and you pay only for candidates who actually take it.
company.practice: We also want preparing for an interview to be free for everyone. Anyone can take our practice interviews for a role, see their grade and every right answer, and practise again, at no cost.

founder.quote: Hiring well shouldn't be a privilege of big companies with big budgets. I built prepza so that any team can turn a job description into a fair interview in minutes, see who really knows the job, and pay only for the candidates who take it. I hope it helps you find the right people faster.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: How prepza works for people with disabilities, what falls short, and how to tell us.
accessibility.intro: We want everyone to be able to use prepza: to take an interview a company sends you, to practise, and to run a company's hiring. We aim to meet level AA of the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2.

done.title: What we do
done.themes: Light and dark themes, following your device's setting.
done.contrast: Colors a company chooses for its interview pages are refused when text on them would be hard to read (below WCAG contrast).
done.languages: The site in 23 languages, right to left where the language is written that way.
done.phones: Pages fit phone screens and work when you zoom in.
done.text: Interview questions are text with answer options: no audio or video is needed.
done.extraTime: A company can give you extra time on each question. Ask the company for it, or for another accommodation, before you start; you don't have to say why.
done.keyboard: From the keyboard: a "Skip to content" link comes first on every page, tabs move with the arrow keys, and screen readers announce a form's errors.

limits.title: What falls short
limits.timed: Interview questions are timed, as the company's assessment requires. If you need more time, ask the company for extra time before you start.
limits.audit: prepza hasn't been audited independently yet, so some parts may not meet WCAG 2.2 AA.
limits.providers: Paying for credits (Paddle's checkout) and the "I'm not a robot" check (Cloudflare Turnstile) are run by those providers, under their own accessibility.

feedback.title: Tell us
feedback.text: If something on prepza is hard for you to use, or you need it in another form, write to <email></email>. We answer within 14 days.
feedback.authority: If you aren't satisfied with our answer, you can contact the Estonian Consumer Protection and Technical Regulatory Authority (TTJA).
